name: wallet-oracle-restart
description: The wallet oracle (rig/WALLET-ORACLE.md) through node lifecycle events, every node on this role's jar: a subject wallet goes through each event in WO_EVENTS (restart, crash, rescan; none = A/A; rescan-from = positive control) and is compared field by field with a reference wallet that holds the same keys and went through nothing. WO_AT=pending compares before the pending payment confirms. Metric same = every event SAME. Expectation, the before/after shape: the base shows a wallet difference in at least one run, the candidate in none. A PR that should not change the wallet reads as NULL with both roles same.
